answer: The canyon counter is kept in orchard and onyx exposes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 43 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An farming party thus has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 43 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. So the marginal impostor costs more than the marginal honest participant earns in 2 epochs. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
